verdict.rationale: The IRS is a government tax-filing and payment service, not a platform where users build automations, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back user-defined automations is outside its product category. The evidence describes filing channels such as MeF, IRIS A2A, and the EIN assistant, but no user-authored automation objects, version history, or rollback, so nothing makes the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
